headline: OAK @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 3.64 at CHC 4.72, with a projected total of 8.35. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: OAK moved -0.24 runs while CHC moved +0.93, changing the projected margin by -1.17 runs. The projected total climbed +0.69, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -15.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jameson Taillon has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Nick Kurtz, Tyler Soderstrom, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
